Respondent :- State Of U.P And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Gambhir Singh
Counsel for Respondent :- Ajay Pratap Singh,Ankit Kumar Pal,G.A.
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, and learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents.

2.  The present writ petition has been filed with the prayer to quash the First Information Report dated 17.03.2024 registered as Case Crime No.131 of 2024 under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P.Act, P.S. Dadri, District Gautam Budh Nagar.

sentences.text: 3. Sri G.P.Singh, learned AGA for the State states that charge-sheet/police report has already been submitted even the cognizance has also taken by the court.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner states that the instant writ petition may be dismissed as not pressed and leave may be accorded to press appropriate remedy.
5. In view of the above, the writ petition is disposed of.
